title: Metadata Routing for RFE and RFECV Feature Selection
mini_srs: This milestone implements SLEP006 metadata routing for the RFE (Recursive Feature Elimination) and RFECV (RFE with Cross-Validation) classes in the feature_selection module. The implementation enables proper routing of parameters to underlying estimators, scorers, and CV splitters through the fit, predict, and score methods. A thread-safety fix for RFECV when used with joblib threading backend is also included. The changes affect sklearn/feature_selection/_rfe.py and sklearn/metrics/_scorer.py, adding comprehensive metadata routing support with backward compatibility for non-routing mode.

title: Estimator Type Detection and Pipeline Fitted State Checks
mini_srs: This milestone extends the tag architecture by moving estimator type identification from the legacy _estimator_type class attribute to the new tags.estimator_type field. Commit 613cff9 modifies BaseEstimator to return Tags with estimator_type=None by default, while ClassifierMixin, RegressorMixin, ClusterMixin, DensityMixin, and OutlierMixin set appropriate type values ('classifier', 'regressor', 'clusterer', 'density_estimator', 'outlier_detector'). The is_classifier(), is_regressor(), is_clusterer(), and is_outlier_detector() functions in sklearn/base.py are updated to use get_tags(estimator).estimator_type instead of getattr(estimator, '_estimator_type'), with deprecation warnings for passing classes instead of instances. Testing infrastructure is enhanced to support multiple estimator instances (938fa18) and remove _required_parameters (95e9459). The _estimator_has function is consolidated into sklearn/utils/validation.py (8f620fd) removing duplicates from ensemble/_bagging.py and ensemble/_stacking.py. Prerequisites include adding base.is_clusterer() function (e16a6dd) and pipeline fitted checks (4dfbfb9).

title: Estimator Validation and Performance Improvements
mini_srs: This milestone moves the BaseEstimator._validate_data() method from a protected method to the public utils.validation.validate_data() function, making data validation a first-class public API. Commit 7d0bec5 removes 260+ lines from sklearn/base.py including _validate_data(), _check_n_features(), and _check_feature_names() methods, relocating them to sklearn/utils/validation.py as the public validate_data() function. All estimators are migrated to call validate_data(self, X, y, ...) instead of self._validate_data(X, y, ...). The refactor enables better Array API support for metrics (53ed13c, e7af195) and addresses validation issues with multilabel data (65b2571). Additional validation enhancements include ensure_non_negative parameter (ea6c77b), force_writeable fixes (a490ab1), and Birch copy parameter deprecation (7c5f13b). The milestone includes metadata routing for SelfTrainingClassifier (cef803a) which requires validation updates, isolation forest parallel prediction (191f969), and nearest neighbors enhancements (f3b1da3, d2f1ea7) including NaN metric support and new prediction methods for NearestCentroid. Commit e5075ae fixes IterativeImputer validation indexing.

title: Array API Support for Metrics and Preprocessing
mini_srs: This milestone establishes Array API support for sklearn metrics and preprocessing. It includes: regression metrics (mean_tweedie_deviance, mean_absolute_error, mean_squared_error, d2_tweedie_score), preprocessing (LabelEncoder), pairwise metrics (cosine_similarity), and infrastructure device handling fixes.

title: Missing Value Support for ExtraTree Estimators
mini_srs: This milestone adds native missing value (NaN) support to ExtraTreeClassifier and ExtraTreeRegressor in sklearn.tree. The implementation extends the random splitter algorithm to handle missing values during both training and prediction. Missing values are partitioned to either the left or right child node based on which branch contains more samples during training, or randomly assigned during splitting when present. The changes modify sklearn/tree/_splitter.pyx to add NaN handling logic in node_split_random function and DensePartitioner.find_min_max method, sklearn/tree/_classes.py to update the _more_tags method to indicate allow_nan=True for random splitters, and sklearn/ensemble/_iforest.py to enable force_all_finite=False validation. Test coverage ensures that tree-based estimators with random splitters properly handle datasets containing missing values.
